study type: Interventional pilot study with survey component
exposure: unrestricted day-and-night hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery using Cambridge FlorenceM system
outcome: parental worry about child's glucose control
desire for more options to input information to the system
cohort: Parents/caregivers of 20 children aged 1 to 7 years (inclusive) with type 1 diabetes participated in the study.
finding: Parents/caregivers of very young children reported important quality of life benefits, including reduced burden of diabetes management, less time spent managing diabetes, improved quality of sleep, and decreased worry about their child's glucose control, associated with using the closed-loop system.
